github.desc: Innovative Artificial Intelligence Applications in Pharmacology Research

github.name: contractility-moa
github.desc: Official repo for our two-stage framework that transforms 1D contractility signals into GAF images and leverages a Swin Transformer to predict mechanisms of action (MoA). Code released post-acceptance. Dataset (gated): pharmaiktu/contractility-signals.

hf.name: PharmAI KTU Contractility Signals
hf.desc: The dataset comprises 578 isometric contractility time series recorded from isolated murine trachea and bladder smooth muscle following exposure to pharmacological agents with distinct receptor-mediated mechanisms of action (MoAs).

hf.name: PCL-PASI: Multi-Task Multi-Device Psoriasis Dataset
hf.desc: PCL-PASI PCL-PASI (Preclinical PASI) is a multi-task multi-device image dataset for psoriasis severity assessment in mice.

hf.name: PCL-PASI — README preview assets
hf.desc: Public companion repository hosting the preview figures that are embedded in the README of the gated main dataset: pharmaiktu/pcl-pasi.
